tools.description: Paid News search via x402 ($0.004 USDC on base). Pass an x402 payment in the X-PAYMENT header. Supports freshness (hour/day/week/month/year), dateFrom/dateTo, page and num up to 100.

tools.name: places_search
tools.description: Maps/places results (name, address, rating, phone, website, lat/lng) for one query, up to 20. Paid via x402 ($0.004 USDC on Base or Solana); send X-PAYMENT, or X-Trial: 1 for free trial calls.

tools.name: shopping_search
tools.description: Shopping product results (title, price, store, rating, url, image) for one query, up to 20. Paid via x402 ($0.004 USDC on Base or Solana); send X-PAYMENT, or X-Trial: 1 for free trial calls.

tools.name: scholar_search
tools.description: Scholar results (title, url, snippet, publication, year, citations, pdf) for one query, up to 20. Paid via x402 ($0.004 USDC on Base or Solana); send X-PAYMENT, or X-Trial: 1 for free trial calls.

tools.name: video_search
tools.description: Video results (title, url, channel, duration, date, thumbnail) for one query, up to 20. Paid via x402 ($0.004 USDC on Base or Solana); send X-PAYMENT, or X-Trial: 1 for free trial calls.

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Search the web, read the top 3-8 pages in parallel and return a concise cited brief with source excerpts. Paid via x402 ($0.08 USDC on Base or Solana); send X-PAYMENT. Not in the free trial. Set answer: true for an LLM-written cited answer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract, image_search, shopping_search, scholar_search, video_search, crawl_site · Private data: lead_finder · Public sink: web_search, image_search, places_search, shopping_search, scholar_search, video_search, deep_research, ai_visibility_check, competitor_report, lead_finder, seo_audit, news_digest, answer, crawl_site, map_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract, image_search, shopping_search, scholar_search, video_search, crawl_site · Private data: lead_finder · Public sink: web_search, image_search, places_search, shopping_search, scholar_search, video_search, deep_research, ai_visibility_check, competitor_report, lead_finder, seo_audit, news_digest, answer, crawl_site, map_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
